unreleased_commits.message:
Accept ruleset rules with GitHub-omitted default parameters

GitHub may omit a ruleset rule's parameters when every parameter uses its default, so exported YAML with a bare rule (e.g. '- type: update') was rejected by validation. Allow rules with no parameters, add regression tests for parse and full export round-trip, and document the behavior.
